title: Design System: 双峰 · 小小梦魇

display.purpose: Existing self-hosted Noto Serif SC subset with system fallbacks; opening title.

shadows.name: miniature
shadows.purpose: Applies only to the loading/error poster, not the live Three.js canvas.

shadows.name: gameplay-contact
shadows.value: support y + .008 world units; strength .62 * exp(-height * 1.3); spread 1 + height * .45; hidden at height >= 3
shadows.purpose: Soft planar patches under player, registered cast and movable props, following the highest eligible solid support. Shader approximation; not ray-traced shadows or global ambient occlusion.

shadows.name: gameplay-cast-shadow-bias
shadows.purpose: Shared gameplay light-shadow calibration in src/game/immersion.js; independent from title viewer and CSS shadows.

motion.name: room-arrive
motion.purpose: Loading/error poster entrance only; disabled by reduced motion.

motion.name: music-thumb
motion.purpose: 12px selected displacement; disabled by reduced motion.

motion.name: title-exit
motion.purpose: Existing title fade; reduced-motion CSS suppresses it.

motion.name: title-camera-drift
motion.purpose: Restrained idle yaw; suppressed during drag and by reduced-motion preference.

motion.name: title-camera-and-light-damping
motion.purpose: Smooth explicit rotation and light intensity transitions.

motion.name: title-canvas-crossfade
motion.purpose: Live canvas replaces fallback when the GLB loads; disabled by reduced motion.

motion.name: title-render-schedule
motion.value: up to 30fps; pixel ratio at most 1.5
motion.purpose: Scheduling and resolution caps, not measured device throughput; hidden-tab render work is skipped.

motion.name: gameplay-lake-normal
motion.purpose: Subtle shader normal perturbation on water/lake standard materials; time freezes at zero with reduced motion.

motion.name: gameplay-velvet-breath
motion.purpose: Small curtain/velvet vertex displacement; time freezes at zero with reduced motion. Does not disable unrelated gameplay animation.

components.name: Enter dream
components.description: Leading start or continue action beside the miniature.

components.description: Underlined quiet action opening archive content.

components.description: Explicit opt-in, shared by title and pause; rendering snippet has no audio behavior.

narrative.overview: A complete interactive Blender miniature sits in a near-black theatre with warm serif lettering and restrained brass actions. A separate Three.js viewer renders the exported GLB, supports bounded mouse/touch/keyboard rotation and toggles real lighting through the floor lamp or an explicit button. The poster is only a loading/error fallback. Entering disposes the viewer and opens the existing eleven-act Three.js game. Falling remains explicit opt-in per visit, independent from environmental effects. There is no paper mode; separate TV mode remains retained. All eleven acts extend this world with support-aware planar contact shadows, restrained environment reflections, selective material microdetail and readable floor depth. Authored chapter lighting remains distinct; gameplay rendering is separate from the title viewer.
keyCharacteristics: Complete interactive miniature silhouette and visible plinth
Clear continue/new-game hierarchy outside the artwork
One live 3D game with keyboard and translucent touch inputs
Explicit music state independent from environmental effects
Grounded puppets and movable props, tactile materials and distinct chapter lighting

rules.name: Whole room
rules.body: Keep the miniature and display plinth visible across responsive title layouts.

rules.name: Honest rendering scope
rules.body: The live title loads an actual Blender-exported GLB in Three.js; the offline Cycles poster is only a loading/error fallback. Runtime materials do not guarantee Cycles parity.

rules.name: Support before atmosphere
rules.body: Align visible feet and movable mesh bases with physical support first. Contact patches follow eligible colliders and fade while airborne; they do not repair geometry or replace collision.

rules.name: Restrained gameplay materials
rules.body: Preserve authored base colors and chapter light cues. Interior environment intensity is .18; shore/forest .045. Selective bump and roughness distinguish cloth, leather, stone and timber without making every material metallic.

rules.name: Source boundaries
rules.body: Title remains governed by .impeccable/red-room-title-brief.md and src/game/title-room.js. Gameplay follows .impeccable/game-immersion-brief.md; immersion.js owns shared treatment, gfx.js rendering/textures, and level/player/world modules authored geometry and support. docs/immersion-audit.md records scope. Neither design file establishes test success or review disposition. Retained tv.html experience is separate.

dos: Do preserve explicit music opt-in each visit.
Do keep environmental effects separately controllable.
Do preserve input, focus and held states.
Do retain editable Blender source and raster provenance.
Do preserve mouse, touch and keyboard room interaction and reduced-motion support.
Do align visible feet, prop bases and collider support before adjusting atmospheric effects.
Do preserve distinct chapter light cues and material differences across all eleven acts.
donts: Don't reintroduce paper mode or a theme picker.
Don't replace the live viewer with the poster except during loading or failure.
Don't promise Cycles material parity in live rendering.
Don't autoplay Falling or persist its enabled state.
Don't equate browser emulation with physical-device tests.
Don't conceal contact or geometry errors with darker grading, thicker fog or stronger bloom.
Don't describe planar contact patches as ray tracing or global ambient occlusion.
